quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: When should you give up your right-of-way?

options.text: Often, even at controlled intersections.
Whenever it helps prevent collisions.
Never. It confuses other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Whenever it helps prevent collisions.
questions.explanation: Do not assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way. Give up your right-of-way whenever it helps prevent collisions.

questions.question: When should you increase the distance between your vehicle and the one ahead?

options.text: When following a small passenger vehicle.
When another driver is tailgating you.
When you are driving slower than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: When another driver is tailgating you.
questions.explanation: When being tailgated, add extra space in front of your vehicle. Do not brake suddenly. Slow down gradually or move to another lane to prevent a crash.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow X on a reversible lane signal mean?

options.text: The signal is about to change to a red X.
The signal is about to change to a green arrow.
Drivers may drive normally in this lane.
Drivers may drive slowly in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The signal is about to change to a red X.
questions.explanation: Reversible lane signals show which lanes are open or closed. A steady yellow X means leave the lane now—it will soon change to a red X.

questions.question: When can you cross solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass traffic moving in the same direction.
During daylight hours only.
At any time.
When making turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: When making turns.
questions.explanation: Broken lines can be crossed. Solid lines cannot be crossed, except when making a turn.

questions.question: Highways and roads freeze before ramps and bridges.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Ramps and bridges freeze faster than regular roads because they are in the air and lose heat quickly. Drive carefully when crossing bridges in cold weather.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a reversible lane signal mean?

options.text: The signal is about to change to a red X.
Drivers should not drive in this lane.
Drivers may use this lane only to make a left turn.
Drivers may drive normally in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may drive normally in this lane.
questions.explanation: Reversible lane signals show which lanes are open or closed. A green arrow means the lane is open and you can drive normally.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic going in opposite directions?

options.text: Yellow
White
Yellow and white
Yellow, white, and black

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow
questions.explanation: Yellow lines are used in the center of roads to separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Stopping distance does NOT depend on:

options.text: Your reaction time.
The time of day.
Your vehicle's brake condition.
Your vehicle's tire condition and type.

questions.correctAnswerText: The time of day.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, road conditions, your vehicle's weight, brakes, and tires, and your speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: What do you do at an intersection with a flashing red light?

options.text: Stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go if safe.
Slow down and go with caution.
Stop and wait for the light to turn green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go if safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a full stop, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.question: How can you avoid hydroplaning when driving in rain?

options.text: Drive at the speed you would in good weather.
Apply your brakes as soon as your car starts to skid.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: When you drive too fast on wet roads, your tires can lose contact with the road. Your car will slide on top of the water. This is called hydroplaning. Driving slower in rain prevents this from happening.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from either direction.
You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
You can pass from the lane with the solid line.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass only from the side with the broken line.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill next to a curb, turn your steering wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will hit the curb and stop.

questions.question: When stopping on snow or ice with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), you should:

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal firmly.
Stay off the brakes and let the car slow down on its own.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal firmly.
questions.explanation: With an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), press the brake pedal firmly and hold it. The ABS will pump the brakes faster than you can.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for trucks.
Do not pass trucks.
Truck parking area ahead.
Steep downgrade ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, you should:

options.text: Brake lightly.
Stay off the brakes.
Brake hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay off the brakes.
questions.explanation: Do not use the brakes if your car is skidding. Braking will make the skid worse.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway angles toward the center. This means:

options.text: There is an intersection just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You must turn left just ahead.
The road will get narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will get narrower.
questions.explanation: A solid line on the edge of the road shows the road's edge. When the line angles toward the center, the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: Which of these guides drivers into the correct lanes for turning on highways?

options.text: Flashing red lights
Flashing yellow lights
White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: Arrows on the road show drivers which lanes to use. They show if you should go straight or turn.

questions.question: A speed restriction sign:

options.text: Can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
Is triangular in shape.
Is blue with black lettering.
Shows a recommended speed for curves or turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows a recommended speed for curves or turns.
questions.explanation: Speed signs on curves and turns show a recommended speed for those areas. You should follow this speed in all weather conditions, especially in rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, complete your turn into:

options.text: The right lane.
The lane closest to your previous lane.
Either lane.
Neither lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane that is closest to where you came from.
